title: Work-Tape Bound for the Machine Bank
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number, and let a machine be assigned to each index in the finite set $	ext{Fin}(d)$. The number of work tapes of the machine at any such index is at most the maximum number of work tapes among the machines in the collection.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $d$ specifies the finite index set.

An index in the set is fixed.
